name: Image To Outline
summary: Converts a photo into a clean outline or line drawing in the browser, officially 100% free, with no watermark and no signup.
description: Image To Outline is a browser tool that turns a JPG, PNG or WEBP photo into a line drawing or outline (styles include pencil sketch, coloring page, Chinese ink and others). Official site copy states it is 100% free, with no watermark and no signup. No paid plan is listed on the official homepage checked.

pricing.details: Officially 100% free, with no watermark and no signup. No paid plan is listed on the official homepage.
pricing.label: Free

features: Photo to outline or line art in the browser
Multiple styles including pencil, coloring page and ink
